judgment.observations: Both images show a steep upward view along warehouse racks, pale pallet loads, yellow fittings, ceiling strip lights and a gridded skylight. The reconstruction captures the overall subject and diagonal perspective, but its large foreground upright dominates the left side, and the skylight sits higher and appears broader. Loads are more uniform, blocklike and densely stacked at the bottom; the reference has more varied package sizes, exposed dark bays, visible pallet bases and irregular wrapping. Rack members appear thicker and lighter, with simplified yellow brackets and fewer visible rails and cross-members. Package-to-shelf contact is less clearly articulated. The reference has glossy, creased translucent wrapping and dark metallic structure; the reconstruction uses flatter beige surfaces and pale framing. Heavy render noise obscures detail, and the lighting lacks the reference’s warm highlights and deep bay shadows.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The rack may be closer to the camera or differently proportioned, judging by the dominant foreground upright and enlarged lower loads, but camera placement could also explain this. Some loads appear flush with or overlapping shelf members; occlusion and noise prevent reliable conclusions about contact or support. Visible differences do not establish the correctness of hidden depth or geometry.
